root_causes: A GB event added the same Burgers vector to both adjoining TJs instead of opposite signed endpoint increments.
A TJ relaxation used one microscopic mode vector while the arriving GB event used the configured packet-scaled vector.
Strict unresolved TJs pinned PF pixels but did not gate further event-resolved GB arrivals.
The finite-residual J2 mode declared a positive-definite residual energy but did not include its energy change in candidate barriers.
All completions in a PF step were selected using rates computed before the first completion changed the TJ residual state.

The FFT eigenstrain closure returned positive self-work and therefore amplified like-signed transformation strain; the Qiu reference PF update instead applies its elastic driving with an explicit minus sign.
repairs: Assign deterministic opposite signs to the two endpoints of each persistent GB domain.
Use the same packet factor for arrival and relaxing modes.
Stop strict GB flux after its first incompatible arrival and gate adjoining GBs until exact relaxation.
Add Delta E_TJ = K_TJ (|B+DeltaB|^2-|B|^2)/2 to finite-residual activation barriers.
Recompute the admissible mode spectrum and rates after every TJ-coupled first passage over the remaining timestep.
Bind each TJ to the nearest correlation domain on each of its three GBs rather than every domain sharing those grain pairs.
Use the negative elastic-energy derivative as the full-field self-stress and require negative source self-work.
admission_policy: The excluded campaigns remain immutable diagnostic evidence. No checkpoint containing the same-sign residual or autocatalytic full-field state is admitted into repaired production; Q1, E1, SC3, SC4, J1, and J2 are rerun whole from time zero.
